/bin/sh -lc "cat > lib/ai/model/tokencount_test.go <<'EOF'
package model

import (
 \"testing\"
 \"github.com/sashabaranov/go-openai\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestTokenCounters(t *testing.T) {
 prompt, err := NewPromptTokenCounter([]openai.ChatCompletionMessage{{Role: openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, Content: \"Hello\"}})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, 5, prompt.TokenCount())
 completion, err := NewSynchronousTokenCounter(\"Hello\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, 4, completion.TokenCount())
 streaming, err := NewAsynchronousTokenCounter(\"Hello\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, streaming.Add())
 require.Equal(t, 5, streaming.TokenCount())
 require.Equal(t, 5, streaming.TokenCount())
 require.Error(t, streaming.Add())
 count := NewTokenCount()
 count.AddPromptCounter(prompt)
 count.AddCompletionCounter(completion)
 require.Equal(t, 5, count.Prompt.CountAll())
 p, c := count.CountAll()
 require.Equal(t, 5, p)
 require.Equal(t, 4, c)
}
EOF
GOPROXY=off go test ./lib/ai/model -run TestTokenCounters -count=1"

/bin/sh -lc "cat >> lib/ai/chat_test.go <<'EOF'

func TestChat_MultipleStepsCount(t *testing.T) {
 responses := []string{"'`{"action":"Unknown tool","action_input":"x"}`, `{"action":"Command Execution","action_input":{"command":"df -h","nodes":["localhost"]}}`}
 var prompts [][]openai.ChatCompletionMessage
 server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
  var request struct { Messages []openai.ChatCompletionMessage `json:"messages"` }
  require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request))
  prompts = append(prompts, request.Messages)
  require.NotEmpty(t, responses)
  fmt.Fprintf(w, "data: {'"\\\"choices\\\":[{\\\"delta\\\":{\\\"content\\\":%q}}]}\\n\\ndata: [DONE]\\n\\n\", responses[0])
  responses = responses[1:]
 }))
 defer server.Close()
 cfg := openai.DefaultConfig(\"secret-test-token\")
 cfg.BaseURL = server.URL + \"/v1\"
 chat := NewClientFromConfig(cfg).NewChat(nil, \"Bob\")
 chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, \"run a command\")
 result, count, err := chat.Complete(context.Background(), \"df\", func(*model.AgentAction) {})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.IsType(t, &model.CompletionCommand{}, result)
 require.Len(t, prompts, 2)
 expectedPrompt, expectedCompletion := 0, 0
 for i, prompt := range prompts {
  p, err := model.NewPromptTokenCounter(prompt)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  c, err := model.NewSynchronousTokenCounter([]string{"'`{"action":"Unknown tool","action_input":"x"}`, `{"action":"Command Execution","action_input":{"command":"df -h","nodes":["localhost"]}}`}[i])
  require.NoError(t, err)
  expectedPrompt += p.TokenCount()
  expectedCompletion += c.TokenCount()
 }
 actualPrompt, actualCompletion := count.CountAll()
 require.Equal(t, expectedPrompt, actualPrompt)
 require.Equal(t, expectedCompletion, actualCompletion)
}
EOF
gofmt -w lib/ai/chat_test.go
GOPROXY=off go test ./lib/ai -run TestChat_MultipleStepsCount -count=1'
